# Database reference

Janus stores everything in an embedded SurrealDB database (22 tables). The schema below is read from `src-tauri/src/db/schema.rs`. Tables marked with an `owner_id` field belong to an account (see {doc}`/developer/accounts`).

## Migrations

Changes that plain `DEFINE ... IF NOT EXISTS` cannot express run once, in order, and are recorded in the `_migrations` table.

| Version | What it does |
|---|---|
| 1 | backfill characters.origin/portrait_status/profile_reviewed for rows that predate those fields |
| 2 | widen provider_configs.provider_type's ASSERT to allow 'tts' (issue #78) |
| 3 | backfill owner_id = '' on root tables for rows that predate accounts (issue #94) |
